name: Rainy Window
description: A rainy night seen from inside through a window: blurred city lights, drops running down the glass and over the glassy clock, a wooden sill with a warm mug.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1
